mapper.select: SELECT orders.*,production.*,inspection.*,targets.*,plans.*,raw_lots.* FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS work_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='READY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS ready_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS in_progress_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS cancelled_count FROM work_order ) orders CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED') THEN p.produced_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS produced_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED') THEN p.good_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS good_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED') THEN p.defect_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS defect_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status NOT IN ('IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS excluded_result_count FROM production_result p JOIN finished_goods_lot f ON f.finished_lot_id=p.finished_lot_id JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id=f.work_order_id ) production CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.inspected_qty),0) AS inspected_qty,COALESCE(SUM(q.accepted_qty),0) AS accepted_qty, COALESCE(SUM(q.rejected_qty),0) AS rejected_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status!='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS invalid_inspection_count FROM quality_inspection q JOIN finished_goods_lot f ON f.finished_lot_id=q.finished_lot_id JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id=f.work_order_id ) inspection CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.inspection_target_qty),0) AS inspection_target_qty, COALESCE(SUM(w.inspection_target_qty-COALESCE(q.inspected_qty,0)),0) AS uninspected_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.inspection_target_qty IS NULL OR w.inspection_target_qty < COALESCE(q.inspected_qty,0) OR (w.inspection_target_qty > 0 AND f.finished_lot_id IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS invalid_target_count FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN finished_goods_lot f ON f.work_order_id=w.work_order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT finished_lot_id,SUM(inspected_qty) AS inspected_qty FROM quality_inspection GROUP BY finished_lot_id) q ON q.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id WHERE w.status='COMPLETED' ) targets CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS plan_count,COALESCE(SUM(planned_qty),0) AS planned_qty FROM production_plan ) plans CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw_lot_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN available_qty=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS exhausted_lot_count FROM raw_material_lot ) raw_lots

SELECT i.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,l.unit_code,COUNT(*) AS lot_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.available_qty=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exhausted_count FROM raw_material_lot l JOIN item i ON i.item_id=l.item_id GROUP BY i.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,l.unit_code ORDER BY i.item_code,l.unit_code

SELECT w.work_order_id,w.production_plan_id,w.status,w.ordered_qty,w.product_unit_code,w.created_at, i.item_code AS product_code,i.item_name AS product_name FROM work_order w JOIN item i ON i.item_id=w.product_item_id ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.work_order_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.production_result_id,p.finished_lot_id,p.produced_qty,p.good_qty,p.defect_qty,p.produced_at,p.worker_ref, f.work_order_id,f.lot_no,i.item_code AS product_code,i.item_name AS product_name FROM production_result p JOIN finished_goods_lot f ON f.finished_lot_id=p.finished_lot_id JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id=f.work_order_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id=w.product_item_id WHERE w.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED') ORDER BY p.produced_at DESC,p.production_result_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT q.inspection_id,q.finished_lot_id,q.round_no,q.inspected_qty,q.accepted_qty,q.rejected_qty,q.inspected_at,q.inspector_ref, f.work_order_id,f.lot_no,i.item_code AS product_code,i.item_name AS product_name FROM quality_inspection q JOIN finished_goods_lot f ON f.finished_lot_id=q.finished_lot_id JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id=f.work_order_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id=w.product_item_id ORDER BY q.inspected_at DESC,q.inspection_id DESC LIMIT 5
